reason: Seed dispersal in the renewing forest seems a plausible way to establish the forest of exchanges.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making pollination was most worthwhile: it connected an insect seeking food with pollen transfer and explained how both partners can benefit.

leastWorthwhile.text: Windborne seeds completed their goal without an explanation of how seeds are adapted for dispersal, making that passage less informative than the surrounding combinations.

surprise.text: Inspecting shore plants automatically created flowers; I hadn't expected the inspection itself to advance the chapter.

arbitrary.text: Combining shore plants with Sun to produce flowers was not obvious to me beforehand; the inspection supplied the connection rather than explaining why sunlight was the particular trigger.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see further ecological connections unfold, especially when the combinations explain relationships as clearly as pollination and seed dispersal did.
